title: Initial velocity expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly derived and stated as v0 = B²L³/(m R₀).

title: Total heat expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly derived and stated as Q_total = 3B⁴L⁶/(25 m R₀²).

title: Apply impulse-momentum theorem
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must relate the magnetic impulse (-B L q) to the change in momentum (mΔv).

title: Calculate total charge flow
description: Important: For part (1), the total charge (q) that flows during the frame's transit through the field must be correctly calculated using Faraday's law and circuit resistance.

title: Analyze circuit resistances
description: Important: For part (2), the equivalent resistance of the circuit must be correctly found for both the entry and exit phases, accounting for series/parallel combinations.

title: Apply energy conservation
description: Important: For part (2), the total heat generated in the circuit during entry/exit must be found using conservation of energy (initial KE = final KE + heat).

title: Distribute heat in circuit
description: Important: For part (2), the heat generated specifically in resistor R₁ must be correctly calculated from the total heat using power/current distribution rules.

title: Sign error in magnetic force
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the direction of the magnetic force (retarding) is ignored, leading to an incorrect sign in the impulse-momentum equation.

title: Incorrect resistance model
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the student fails to recognize the changing circuit configuration (which sides are in the field) and uses a constant equivalent resistance.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly verifies the dimensional consistency of their final expressions (e.g., for velocity or energy).
